test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When was the three-language policy implemented in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1968**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the** National Education Policy of 1968,** the three-language formula means that a third language **(apart from Hindi and English), **which should belong to Modern India, should be used for education in Hindi-speaking states.
 
• The** three-language formula **is a language learning policy first formulated** in 1968 by the Ministry of Education **of the Government of India in consultation with the states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The formula is enunciated in the 1968** National Policy Resolution.**
 
• It provided for the study of** "Hindi, English and modern Indian language** (preferably one of the southern languages) in the Hindi speaking states and Hindi, English and the **Regional language in the non-Hindi speaking States".**
